{{Quote|If you're in such a rush to get downstairs, then jump out the window.|A young Hego Damask to the Muun youngling|<ref name="Darth P" />}}
A '''young Muun''' was among a group of [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] brought to the [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] by one of the [[Darth Plagueis's mother|wives]] of [[Caar Damask]], the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of the world, for the sole purpose of being a playmate for their son, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]]. One afternoon, the young Muun pushed past Hego while trying to reach the staircase that went down to the lower-level courtyard of the [[Damask clan|Damask]] [[Damask residence|residence]]. Hego, who had grown to dislike the youth, grabbed the Muun's upper [[Limb/Legends|arm]] and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], [[Mind trick/Legends|suggesting]] that if the youngling was in such a hurry, to jump out the [[Window/Legends|window]] instead. Locking [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] with the youngster and repeating the suggestion, Hego managed to convince the youth to jump to [[Death/Legends|death]]. Though many questions were raised following the youngling's death, the young Damask revealed the truth of his trick only to his mother.<ref name="Darth P" />

==Behind the scenes==
The young Muun appeared in a flashback sequence in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth P" />
